name: Gudiyatham

queries.query: Gudiyatham Tamil Nadu official cadastral parcel map land records GIS
queries.result: Found first-party Tamil Nadu land-record e-Services, TamilNilam Geo-Info, TNGIS, Vellore/Gudiyatham municipal and Gudiyatham planning references. Official material confirms Patta/FMB/Chitta/TSLR and cadastral-map-related services, but discovery did not expose a safe anonymous parcel feature endpoint.

Found official Tamil Nadu land-record and TNGIS references, plus the official Gudiyatham municipal Tamil-facing portal. The results support state Survey and Land Records custody and public land-record procedures, but no safe anonymous parcel polygon response was exposed.

registryEvidence: Tamil Nadu's official land-record service and NIC Tamil Nadu announcement identify the Department of Survey and Settlement / Revenue and Disaster Management as custodians of digitized land records, including FMB/maps and Chitta. The official Gudiyatham Municipality portal confirms the local municipal jurisdiction and its land-services context. This evidences a state/local registry custodian, not an admitted parcel API.
uncertainty: No safe native parcel identity, parcel polygon, public service schema, or CRS response was obtained. The official e-Services host timed out on an anonymous TLS-verified GET with browser-like headers; TNGIS was a public page with a login/CAPTCHA shell; TamilNilam was identified as a public land-record/map application but no anonymous geometry endpoint was qualified. These outcomes do not establish citywide absence or lack of cadastral coverage.
